args.body: The prior failure stands. Read the receipt and, if committed, google-merchant-products-v1-proto.txt in the existing sample directory. Inspect the exact item_group_id definition and any linked requirements. If it supports a concrete validator rule, open a successor mission limited to that rule and execute fictional passing and failing feeds against it. Save actual output, source hash and a copy-ready operator example for a merchant with the matching problem. If the definition only identifies the field or leaves the rule ambiguous, record the remaining requirement before making any compliance claim. A field specification is technical evidence. A current buyer request or eligible inquiry is separate. No outreach or deployment.

description: The Merchant API overview omitted the variant grouping rule, and the earlier field-page fetch exceeded the host response limit. A first-party API definition offers a specific way to check whether the failed sample can be reopened. If it establishes an actionable rule, the next deliverable is a tested preflight example an operator can show a merchant. The feedback feed still has five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 verified available and no verified revenue. The count-only acceptance check can proceed independently without spending.
